items.text: Jump between dashboard and config with < — < (that's Shift+,, next to the , page overview) opens config from the dashboard, and takes you back to the dashboard from config — asking to confirm first if there are unsaved changes. It's on the cheat sheet (! / F1) and Config → Keyboard.

Config → General opens compact on first visit — a fresh first open lands on Essentials with only Localisation expanded instead of four sections at once. Once you expand or collapse a section, your own layout is remembered.
